rounds.text: Pacific Industries Ltd is currently trading at a deep discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of just 0.21x [E2]. While the market has focused on recent earnings volatility, the company has successfully expanded its operating margin to 6% in March 2026, up from 4% three years earlier [E22]. This improvement in operational efficiency is further supported by recent quarter-over-quarter sales growth [E59]. Conceded: [E1], [E4], [E6], [E7], [E8], [E11], [E12], [E13], [E54], [E61], [E62]. Despite the broader sector experiencing 17.7% profit growth [E67], the current market capitalization of ₹ 93.7 Cr [E3] suggests that the stock is priced for failure, ignoring the underlying margin expansion [E22]. The stock’s position at only 24% of its 52-week range [E5] provides a significant margin of safety for investors who recognize the potential for a turnaround in profitability.
